limitations_and_boundaries: Mosaic-seq relies on antibiotic selection, limiting application to proliferating cells (page 14).
Cannot distinguish primary enhancer targets from downstream secondary effects (page 14).
Due to detection limits of scRNA-seq, applying to enhancers regulating lowly expressed genes likely requires more reads or cells (page 14).
Mosaic-seq is about 83x more expensive than high-throughput reporter assays, limiting genome-wide application until sequencing costs decrease (page 14).
Unknown whether KRAB is a universal repressor of all enhancers; false negatives possible (page 14).

research_questions.statement: How to systematically measure endogenous enhancer activity at single-cell resolution and in combination?

provenance.text_excerpt: These results suggest that Mosaic-seq can robustly and specifically detect changes in gene expression induced by epigenome engineering of single cells in a manner that is consistent with traditional approaches.

claims.statement: Mosaic-seq can robustly and specifically detect changes in gene expression induced by epigenome engineering in single cells, consistent with traditional approaches.

provenance.text_excerpt: Overall, we find that these constituents have a widely variable effect on gene expression when averaged across cells, ranging from 18.0% to 88.9%, with a median of 42.3%. In contrast, most constituents tested elicit no detectable changes in expression, suggesting that they only contribute weakly to gene expression, at least when studied in isolation with KRAB.

claims.statement: Only a small number of constituent enhancers are major effectors of target gene expression when repressed by KRAB.

provenance.text_excerpt: These observations suggest that simultaneous repression of multiple weak constituents can robustly alter super-enhancer activity and that it does so in a manner that is significantly greater than the repression of individual constituents.

claims.statement: Simultaneous repression of multiple weak constituent enhancers can alter super-enhancer activity in a manner greatly exceeding repression of individual constituents.

claims.statement: Binding of p300 and RNAPII are key features of active constituent enhancers.

datasets.name: TNF-alpha stimulation single-cell data

experiments_or_tasks: Apply Mosaic-seq to 71 constituent enhancers from 15 super-enhancers (page 5, 8).
Combinatorial Mosaic-seq on TAD2 SE2 constituents (page 13).
Develop Mosaic-seq to jointly measure a cell's transcriptome and its sgRNA modulators, quantifying effects of dCas9-KRAB-mediated enhancer repression in single cells (page 2).
Test Mosaic-seq on ten sgRNAs targeting HS2, HBG1/2, HBE1, and negative controls in K562 cells (page 5).
TNF-alpha stimulation experiment to create gold-standard datasets for differential expression analysis (page 5).

methods.name: Mosaic-seq
methods.protocol_description: Infect wild-type cell line with lentiviral dCas9-KRAB-blast vector, then with barcoded sgRNA-puro lentiviral library, select with antibiotics, perform Drop-seq, and associate single-cell transcriptomes with sgRNA barcodes (page 2).

methods.name: Virtual FACS
methods.protocol_description: Statistical framework using hypergeometric test to compare distribution of single-cell expression between perturbed and control cells (page 5).

methods.name: Penetrance and contribution modeling
methods.protocol_description: Statistical model fitting to estimate single-cell penetrance (percentage of cells with altered expression) and expression contribution (level of repression in those cells) (page 10).

study_units.name: Mosaic-seq method development and validation
